cohort: The study included women with singleton pregnancies after 37 completed weeks of gestation who underwent a second-stage caesarean section at Theni Medical College Hospital.
finding: Second-stage caesarean section is associated with increased maternal and fetal morbidity.
mod_finding: Second-stage caesarean section, as a mode of birth, is associated with increased maternal and fetal morbidity including PPH, LUS tear, perinatal asphyxia, and respiratory distress.
gest_age: After 37 completed weeks of gestation (average delivery at 38 weeks)
